articles.headline: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms
articles.description: Three days of secret talks resulted in Mark Walter flipping the Lakers -- and reignited yet another round of bickering among the six Buss siblings.

images.name: Lakers [1296x729]
images.caption: The summer sale of the Lakers sent shockwaves across the sports world, and sent the organization into chaos -- again.
images.credit: AP Photo, Getty Images, Imagn Images

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo2 [576x324]
images.caption: When Jeanie Buss sold the Lakers to Walter, she showed Doncic paperwork that assured him that she would still be in charge of his basketball future. Ten months later, that promise is no longer certain.

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo3 [576x324]
images.caption: The second sale of the Lakers put the team in significant transition again -- with new owners evaluating everything and squabbling former owners jostling for power and money. Iger and Kushner are Doncic's fifth team owners in the past three years.

article.headline: Celtics and Bulls meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (3-1, fourth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Celtics and Bulls meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Celtics and Bulls meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (3-1, fourth in the Eastern Conference) Boston; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Celtics -11.5; over/under is 232.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Boston Celtics take on the Chicago Bulls in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Boston finished 56-26 overall and 36-16 in Eastern Conference action last season. The Celtics gave up 107.2 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season. Chicago went 31-51 overall and 19-32 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls averaged 7.6 steals, 5.0 blocks and 14.6 turnovers per game last season. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Celtics won 134-99 in the last matchup on Oct. 26. INJURIES: Celtics: Devin Carter: out (illness). Bulls: Tobe Awaka: day to day (ankle), Patrick Williams: day to day (groin), Nic Claxton: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
